column1: # boru Language Specification: the boru:scry module
# A boru system's knowledge of itself, as plain data (design/BORU-SCRY.0.md).
# Import binds the `Scry` namespace. boru:scry is the canonical home of the
# seven self-knowledge words boru:debug shipped first; both modules build
# them from ONE constructor, and the Debug copies are frozen and deprecated
# (NUR063) — §4 pins that the two surfaces answer alike.

column3: defs returns the active def bindings as a map
defs maps a def-bound name to its binding
modules returns the importable native modules
sig returns the word's signatures as structured data
sig of an unknown word raises

column1: import "boru:scry" def f fn [[x:Integer] [Integer] [x add 1]] end ("f" Scry.body) typeof
column3: a boru-defined word reports its quoted body
body of an unknown word raises
deps returns the distinct referenced words (add, mul)
a body that references no word has no deps
shape on a bare type literal does not panic

column1: # §4  one constructor, two surfaces — boru:debug's deprecated copies agree

column3: sig answers alike on both surfaces

column1: import "boru:scry" import "boru:debug" ([1 add 2 mul 3] Scry.deps) deq ([1 add 2 mul 3] Debug.deps)
column3: deps answers alike on both surfaces
modules answers alike on both surfaces
